input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (Article III) is entirely Licensor-side: Licensor owns the Licensed Technology and all IP therein, and "Derivative Work" is defined to capture "any additions, modifications, improvements or enhancements based upon or incorporating the Licensed Technology". The customization work and unique client front end that we pay for under Article VII(b) therefore vest in Licensor with no ownership, assignment or lasting licence back to us; our only rights are a non-exclusive, Field-of-Use licence that Article XXI extinguishes on termination, and Article II bars us from modifying or sublicensing. There is also no statement of our rights in our own trading/transaction data. That fails every deliverables-licence element of the fallback, so we take the fallback rather than preferred: Licensor keeps ownership of its platform and know-how (already met by Article III), and we add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Deliverables for our business, plus a limit confining any Licensor right in our data to processing it solely to provide the services. Article XXI is conformed so the Deliverables licence is not automatically terminated.

proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense customization deliverables, limit Licensor's rights in our data, and conform the termination clause.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We pay for the customization work under Article VII, but Article III and the "Derivative Work" definition leave Licensor owning it with no lasting rights for us, so we add our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those deliverables for our business, and a limit confining any Licensor right in our data to processing it solely to provide the services. We conform Article XXI so the deliverables licence is not extinguished on termination; Licensor keeps ownership of the Licensed Technology and its know-how.

ops.text: Any customization work, unique client front end, enhancements and other deliverables developed by Licensor for Licensee under this Article VII (the "Deliverables") are licensed to Licensee, notwithstanding the restrictions in Article II, on a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide and royalty-free basis to use, modify and sublicense the Deliverables for Licensee's business. Any license or other right of Licensor in or to Licensee's data, including trading and transaction data, is limited to processing that data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
